title: 第7章 皇帝大公第8章 不是坏事
content_zh:
;;
克洛伊不知道是第几次来到这个地方。
这水天一色如梦似幻空间，在他看来，比起真正地狱都要恐怖百倍！
他目光有些呆滞空洞地看向对面那个虐杀了他几百次的恶魔，没有愤怒，没有恐惧，只有习惯后的麻木。
哈……对死亡感到习惯什么的也太奇怪了吧……
即便到了这种程度，他还是忍不住在心里吐槽。
嗖——
破风声响起的瞬间，克洛伊就知道对面那人影在向自己冲来。
没有任何迟疑，几乎本能般地，克洛伊抬手便是一道冰盾凝结而出。
“砰——！”
枪盾交击，发出沉闷的巨响，冰屑四溅！
那面足以抵挡高级魔法轰击的冰盾，在对方狂暴的力量下，仅仅支撑了一瞬便轰然炸裂！
但就是这一瞬，为克洛伊争取到了宝贵的反应时间！
他借着冰盾爆裂的冲击力向后滑退，同时右手紧握凭空出现的长枪，手腕猛地一抖，枪尖划出一道凄冷的弧线，如同毒蛇出洞，直撩对方持枪的手腕！
然而那身影的动作丝毫未停。
枪身回旋，用枪尾精准无比地磕开克洛伊的撩击，火星在兵刃交击处迸射！
紧接着，人影踏步一个后空翻拉开距离，伸手五指一握，克洛伊脚下的水面瞬间冻结，无数尖锐的冰刺如同钢铁丛林般猛然向上突刺。
范围之大，几乎覆盖了他所有闪避的空间。
但在对方抬起手的瞬间，克洛伊就已经采取了行动，他双腿灌注魔力，猛地踩碎脚下冰面，身体如同炮弹般冲天而起。
几乎同时，他右手一挥，无数冰棱冰锥便在他面前铺开，如同暴雨梨花般朝着地上的身影碾射。

然而，面对这铺天盖地的攻击，人影却也丝毫不闪不避，他脚下一跺，一道巨大的冰墙便拔地而起。
密集的破碎声顿时响彻。
而这却也正是克洛伊释放这波aoe魔法的用意！
趁着人影视线受阻的刹那，他落地的瞬间，便踏步前冲，同样的伸手虚握，霎时一只完全由冰凝结而成的巨鲸自水面之下跃起，一口将冰墙后的人影吞下，冰封在体内。
克洛伊眼神一狠，冲势更猛几分，几乎眨眼的瞬间，他便冲到了冰封巨鲸的面前。
凝聚所有力气与魔力的一枪惯出。
然而就在枪尖即将戳爆人影脑袋中的前一瞬间，冰鲸突然破碎。
千钧一发间，那人影用一只手，拦住了克洛伊的这致命一枪。
“噗嗤！”
枪尖毫无阻碍地刺穿了他的手掌，鲜血四溅。
第一次，他被克洛伊的攻势击伤了。
然而，他仿佛感觉不到疼痛，被刺穿的手掌猛地收紧，五指如同铁钳般死死攥住枪身，然后——用力朝自己方向狠狠一拉！
content_en:
;;
Chloe didn't know how many times she had come to this place.
This dream-like space of water and sky was, in his opinion, a hundred times more terrifying than the real hell!
His eyes were dull and empty as he looked at the demon opposite him who had tortured him hundreds of times. There was no anger or fear, only numbness after getting used to it.
Ha...it's so weird to be used to death...
Even at this level, he still couldn't help but complain in his heart.
Whoosh——
The moment the sound of breaking wind sounded, Chloe knew that the figure on the opposite side was rushing towards her.
Without any hesitation, almost instinctively, Chloe raised her hand and an ice shield condensed out.
"Bang——!"
The guns and shields clashed, making a dull noise, and ice shards flew everywhere!
The ice shield, which was strong enough to withstand the bombardment of high-level magic, exploded under the violent power of the opponent after only supporting it for a moment!
But it was this moment that bought Chloe precious reaction time!
He used the impact of the ice shield to slide back. At the same time, he clenched the spear that appeared out of thin air with his right hand. His wrist shook violently, and the tip of the spear drew a cold arc, like a poisonous snake coming out of its hole, directly licking the opponent's gun-holding wrist!
However, the figure's movements did not stop at all.
The gun body spun around and used the tail of the gun to knock off Chloe's strike with great precision. Sparks burst out where the weapons collided!
Immediately afterwards, the figure stepped forward and did a backflip to distance himself. He stretched out his hand and grasped it with five fingers. The water under Chloe's feet froze instantly, and countless sharp ice spikes suddenly stabbed upward like a steel jungle.
The range was so large that it almost covered all the space for him to dodge.
But the moment the opponent raised his hand, Chloe had already taken action. Infused with magic power, his legs crushed the ice beneath his feet, and his body rose into the sky like a cannonball.
Almost at the same time, he waved his right hand, and countless icy cones spread out in front of him, crushing towards the figure on the ground like a rainstorm of pear blossoms.
However, facing this overwhelming attack, the figure did not dodge at all. He stamped his feet and a huge ice wall rose from the ground.
A dense shattering sound suddenly resounded.
And this is precisely the intention of Chloe to release this wave of AOE magic!
Taking advantage of the moment when the figure's sight was blocked, the moment he landed, he stepped forward and extended his hand to hold it. In an instant, a giant whale made entirely of ice jumped up from the water, swallowed the figure behind the ice wall in one mouthful, and sealed it in his body.
Chloe's eyes were fierce, and his momentum became a little fiercer. In the blink of an eye, he rushed in front of the frozen giant whale.
He gathered all his strength and magic power into one shot.
However, just before the tip of the spear was about to explode into the figure's head, the ice whale suddenly shattered.
At the critical moment, the figure stopped Chloe's fatal shot with one hand.
"Pfft!"
The tip of the spear pierced his palm without any hindrance, and blood splattered everywhere.
The first time, he was injured by Chloe's attack.
However, he didn't seem to feel the pain. The pierced palm suddenly tightened, his five fingers tightly grasped the gun body like iron pliers, and then - he pulled hard in his direction!
